actions.tree: LineComment: // A null input must be rejected even when the other input is a valid (empty) CharSequence. [2515,2606]
LineComment: // Every combination involving a null SimilarityInput must be rejected, [2959,3030]
LineComment: // regardless of whether the threshold is zero or unset (null). [3039,3102]
LineComment: // With a threshold of 0, any non-zero distance is reported as -1 (threshold exceeded). [4614,4701]
LineComment: // The CharSequence overload and the SimilarityInput overload must agree. [4961,5034]
LineComment: // The CharSequence overload and the SimilarityInput overload must produce equal results. [5781,5870]
LineComment: // a result must equal itself (reflexivity) [6385,6428]
LineComment: // Two empty inputs: distance of zero with no operations. [6438,6495]
LineComment: // The SimilarityInput overload must produce a result equal to the CharSequence overload. [7841,7930]
LineComment: // Each case checks the unlimited (no-threshold) distance and its insert/delete/substitute breakdown. [9114,9215]
LineComment: // Two empty inputs: no edits required. [9225,9264]
LineComment: // "hippo" -> "elephant": the mirror case, 3 insertions and 4 substitutions. [10371,10447]
LineComment: // "zzzzzzzz" -> "hippo": the mirror case, 3 deletions and 5 substitutions. [10818,10893]
LineComment: // Each case applies a threshold-limited distance. When the true distance exceeds the [11327,11412]
LineComment: // threshold, the algorithm gives up and reports a distance of -1 with all counts zeroed. [11421,11510]
LineComment: // Threshold large enough: the exact result is returned. [11520,11576]
LineComment: // Threshold 0 with differing single characters: exceeded. [11996,12054]
LineComment: // Identical inputs: distance 0, within any non-negative threshold. [12240,12307]
LineComment: // "aaa" -> "bbb": three substitutions; only allowed when threshold >= 3. [12495,12568]
LineComment: // Mixed delete + substitute cases within threshold. [12761,12813]
LineComment: // "a" -> "bbb": two insertions and one substitution; allowed when threshold >= 3. [13009,13091]
LineComment: // Thresholds too small for the required edits: all exceeded. [13372,13433]
LineComment: // Length difference alone (2) already exceeds threshold 1. [13897,13956]
LineComment: // "elephant" <-> "hippo": distance 7, allowed only when threshold >= 7. [14388,14460]
LineComment: // With Integer.MAX_VALUE the threshold never binds, so results match the unlimited algorithm. [15351,15445]
